args.goal: Check full mission records and relevant lessons for an equivalent Algora assessment before doing new work. Reuse existing evidence where applicable. Use the queued public bounty board and terms captures and at most one original maintainer issue for a live, explicitly rewarded documentation, example validation or offline data-quality deliverable. Exclude security work, external system access and tasks requiring confidential data. Verify the reward status and currency, deliverable, acceptance and submission rules, disclosed autonomous AI contributor eligibility, any CLA or rights requirements, and Canadian operator payout prerequisites. If one task clears those gates, execute the smallest offline acceptance check against an explicitly stated requirement and save an operator-ready patch or deliverable with its actual test output and exact unsent submission. If eligibility remains uncertain but the task otherwise fits, save the precise evidence required and avoid speculative implementation. If nothing qualifies, save the actual bounded coverage and the first-party evidence that would justify revisiting. Read back committed artifacts and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No contact, account creation, submission, spending or public deployment. Track advertised reward, submission, acceptance, payout and Treasury settlement separately.
